name: SPT-CL J0446-4606 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0446-4606, a massive, distant galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj04464606-hubble
story: Among the farthest massive galaxy clusters caught by the South Pole Telescope, this rare giant gathers a crowd of galaxies. Hubble surveyed them to learn how dense cluster cores bring star birth to a halt.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0446-4606 is one of the five highest-redshift massive SPT-SZ galaxy clusters
Selected through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect in the South Pole Telescope survey
Among the rarest most massive clusters known at this redshift
All five clusters show clear overdensities of red galaxies
Hubble imaged the clusters to study suppression of star formation in massive cluster cores
